title: Blockpedia MCP compare blocks output
description: Every requested block in block_ids order. Each block describes its representative (first visual variant) as get_block_details does; fields equal for all blocks are given once under shared.

shared.description: Fields with the same value for every block, written once instead of in each block. When semantics or family differ as a whole, shared.semantics or shared.family holds the keys that are still equal for every block, and each block keeps only its own keys.

differing_fields.description: Fields whose values are not all equal across blocks; they are the compared fields present in blocks.

candidate_id.description: Label of this block's card on the contact sheet; absent when the block has no visual variant.

block.description: One requested block. Every compared field is either here, when its value differs between blocks, or once under shared, when it is the same for all of them.

lightness.description: CIELAB L* of the mean colour.

lightness_std.description: Standard deviation of per-pixel L*: near 0 smooth (concrete), about 4 stone, 10+ mottled (cobblestone).

dominant.description: Up to three colour clusters, largest first; clusters under 10% of the face are left out.

colors.description: Texture colours of the top face and the side faces (north and east views), read from the preview with the renderer's fixed face shading divided back out. A face with too few visible pixels is null. When top and side are within Oklab ΔE 2 (×100) and 2 L* spread of each other they are given once as top_and_side, with the top face's figures.

family.description: Shapes this block's material comes in, from the registry naming rule (oak_planks: oak_stairs, oak_slab ...). base_block is the material's full block (the block itself when it has no forms, as spruce_log), null when there is none (petrified_oak_slab); forms names the shapes, empty when the full block has none, and a form's block ID is form_id_pattern with {form} replaced (minecraft:oak_{form}: minecraft:oak_stairs). material_blocks, when present, lists every full block of the same material in other finishes, base_block included, as templates: a block ID is minecraft: plus the template with * replaced by material (material spruce: *_log, *_planks, *_wood, stripped_*_log, stripped_*_wood; material tuff: *, polished_*, *_bricks, chiseled_* ...); a copper block's wax and oxidation stage are part of its material and stay in the template (exposed_cut_*). In a comparison, family keys equal for every block (often forms and material_blocks) are given once under shared.family and the rest per block; together they form each block's family: base_block and forms are always present, form_id_pattern exactly when forms is non-empty, material together with material_blocks.

material.description: Material word that replaces * in material_blocks.

image.description: Lossless WebP contact sheet, one tile per block with a candidate_id, labelled with its candidate_id and block_id ("T01 stone"). image="full" (default): 256x256 cards of the four views; image="compact": the isometric and top views at 64px side by side (128 wide) above a label strip as tall as the longest label needs; image="none": no sheet.

content_index.description: Index of the ImageContent in the tool result content array.

columns.description: Tiles per row. Tiles are row-major in candidate order: T01 is the first tile, so candidate n is at row (n-1) div columns, column (n-1) mod columns; tile width is width / columns and tile height is height / rows; each tile is labelled with its candidate_id and block_id ("T01 stone").

shape_class.description: Registry-tag shape (stairs, slab, wall, fence, door, trapdoor, pane ...), else from the representative geometry: full_cube (solid full block), passable (no collision: plants, torches, rails), sheet (flat on the floor), small_fixture (at most half a block across: lanterns, flower pots, heads), partial_block (the rest: chests, cauldrons, anvils); other when there is no representative geometry.

semantics.description: Published semantic fields of the representative visual variant; null when the block has no visual variant. Only the English summary; get_block_details has both languages. When semantics differ, a key equal for every block is under shared.semantics instead.
